_comment: Override for TANUH's MViT2 oral-cancer fold ensemble (model6/model8/model8-2 → mvit2_fold1_6/fold1_8/fold2_8). Runs on ONNX Runtime Mobile (engine=onnx) against the ONNX exports of the three folds — input [1,3,256,256], single-logit [1,1] sigmoid-binary head. Preprocessing follows the validated reference: bicubic resize to 256, gray-world white-balance (per-channel mean→128, clip), straight uint8 cast, then /255 → [0,1] BGR CHW. The JS EdgeModelService combines the 3 folds by unanimous AND — suspicious only when all folds agree. interpolation=cubic → preprocessing/Preprocessors.kt bicubicResize (cv2.INTER_CUBIC parity); decoder → SigmoidBinaryDecoder.
